title: Multipart Block Column Feature
description: `minecraft:multipart_block_column_feature` places blocks in an ordered column consisting of 1-4 parts. When the column consists of one block, only the 'tip_block' is placed. When the column consists of two blocks, a 'frustum_block' is placed with a 'tip_block' above it. For a three block column, a 'base_block' is placed at the bottom, and followed by a 'frustum_block' and a 'tip_block'. For columns larger than three blocks, the 'middle_block' is used as padding between the 'base_block' and the 'frustum_block'. 'height_range' specifies the range of blocks the column can be in any direction. 'weighted_heights' specifies a list of possible weighted lengths the column can be in any direction. Exactly one of 'height_range' or 'weighted_heights' has to be specified. 'direction' specifies the direction of the column. This can be any direction. 'may_place_on' can be used to limit what blocks a column can be placed upon. If omitted a column can be placed anywhere

tip_block.title: Tip Block
tip_block.description: The topmost block of the column.

frustum_block.title: Frustum Block
frustum_block.description: The second topmost block below the tip if the column is at least two blocks

middle_block.title: Middle
middle_block.description: The block that is placed between the base and frustum blocks when the column is at least four blocks

base_block.title: Base Block
base_block.description: The bottom-most block when the column is at least three blocks

height_range.title: Height Range
height_range.description: The range of blocks the column can be high

range_min.title: Range Min
range_min.description: The lower bound of the range.

range_max.title: Range Max
range_max.description: The upper bound of the range.

weighted_heights.title: Weighted Heights
weighted_heights.description: Collection of weighted heights that placement will select from.

items.title: Weight
items.description: Weight used in random selection. Value is relative to other weights in the collection.

may_place_on.title: May Place On
may_place_on.description: A list of blocks that may be replaced during placement. Omit this field to allow any block to be replaced.

may_replace.title: May Replace
may_replace.description: A list of blocks that may be replaced during placement. Omit this field to allow any block to be replaced.
